title.value: Post an app's social media automatically with Codex

introduction.value: A commenter uses Codex with a Chrome plugin and an automation to post to their app's social accounts while working a separate job.

method.value: In the comments, one user said they use Codex to run social accounts for their app while they work another job as a groundsman for a tree company. They said the setup was an automation plus the Chrome plugin, with everything left open on their computer so it could post automatically; they also clarified they do not use it for Twitter/X or Reddit because those platforms would not allow it.

outcome.value: They said it helped a lot because they had barely had time to post otherwise. The thread gives no metrics, and the main limitation stated is that Twitter/X and Reddit would not let them automate posting this way.

notes.value: The practical catch is you have to keep the needed pages open on your computer, and some platforms will block or ban this kind of automation.

Post an app's social media automatically with Codex
A commenter uses Codex with a Chrome plugin and an automation to post to their app's social accounts while working a separate job.
Done with
CX
Codex
What they did
In the comments, one user said they use Codex to run social accounts for their app while they work another job as a groundsman for a tree company. They said the setup was an automation plus the Chrome plugin, with everything left open on their computer so it could post automatically; they also clarified they do not use it for Twitter/X or Reddit because those platforms would not allow it.
How it went
They said it helped a lot because they had barely had time to post otherwise. The thread gives no metrics, and the main limitation stated is that Twitter/X and Reddit would not let them automate posting this way.
Worth knowing
The practical catch is you have to keep the needed pages open on your computer, and some platforms will block or ban this kind of automation.
Try it yourself
with
Codex
Copy prompt
Set up a recurring automation that drafts and posts to my app's [Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram] accounts [number] times a week, based on [recent releases, changelog, or my notes folder]. Write the posts in [tone] and keep a log of what was posted and when. Before posting each one, show me the draft and wait for my approval until I tell you otherwise.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/codex/comments/1ugh9c6/this_changed_my_life
